_comment: Real Secure Enclave signatures from spike2 (SecKeyCreateSignature, ecdsaSignatureMessageX962SHA256, four throwaway keys that were never stored and ended with their process). message is what was signed (69 bytes: authenticator data and the client data hash for the first signature of each key, random after), der is what the chip answered, raw is r || s from that DER and low is raw with S = n - S when S > n / 2, both computed by spike2 with noble-curves. high is whether the chip returned a high S. All hex.
